title.original: AIP: Agent Identity Protocol for Verifiable Delegation Across MCP and A2A
title.zh: AIP：跨MCP和A2A的可验证委派的代理身份协议
title.en: AIP: Agent Identity Protocol for Verifiable Delegation Across MCP and A2A

inclusion_reason.zh: AIP 的可衰减 IBCT、跨传输适配器和完成来源链为 MCP/A2A 多跳委托提供低开销身份授权基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: AIP's attenuable IBCTs, cross-transport adapters, and completion provenance provide low-overhead identity and authorization infrastructure for MCP/A2A delegation.

abstract.zh: AIP 以 Invocation-Bound Capability Token 将身份、可衰减委托授权和完成来源绑定在同一追加链中，贯通 MCP、A2A 与 HTTP。
abstract.en: AIP's Invocation-Bound Capability Tokens combine identity, attenuable delegated authority, and completion provenance in one append-only chain across MCP, A2A, and HTTP.

problem.zh: MCP 和 A2A 默认不验证 Agent 身份，普通 JWT 又难表达持有者侧权限衰减、多跳策略和调用上下文绑定。
problem.en: MCP and A2A do not verify agent identity by default, and plain JWTs cannot express holder-side attenuation, multi-hop policy, and invocation-context binding.

approach.zh: 协议为单跳提供签名 JWT 紧凑模式，为多跳使用带 Datalog 策略的 Biscuit 链，并把传输调用与完成记录纳入 token 证明。
approach.en: The protocol uses signed JWTs for compact single-hop cases and Biscuit chains with Datalog policy for multi-hop delegation, binding transports and completion records.

system_design.zh: Python/Rust SDK 负责签发、衰减、转发和验证 IBCT，MCP/A2A/HTTP 适配器注入调用上下文，审计器保存委托与完成链。
system_design.en: Python and Rust SDKs issue, attenuate, forward, and verify IBCTs; protocol adapters bind invocation context, and auditors retain delegation and completion chains.

key_results.zh: 跨语言实现互操作且验证开销很低，真实多 Agent 部署额外延迟可忽略；攻击测试全部被拒，链式模型捕获普通 JWT 漏掉的类别。
key_results.en: Cross-language implementations interoperate at low verification cost, add negligible latency in deployment, and reject all tested attacks, including categories plain JWT misses.

limitations.zh: 测试攻击和扫描 Server 范围有限；密钥生命周期、撤销、信任根、策略冲突以及 token 元数据隐私仍需完整运行治理。
limitations.en: Attack tests and server scans are bounded; key lifecycle, revocation, trust roots, policy conflicts, and token-metadata privacy still require operational governance.

metrics.name: Real MCP-over-HTTP overhead versus no authentication
